eligibility: Manufacturer whose product is covered by a BIS Indian Standard and, where compulsory, by a QCO. Manufacturer must have the required manufacturing infrastructure, in-process controls, quality control and testing capability, and the product must conform to the applicable IS. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
application_procedure: Apply online through Manakonline; select the applicable product/IS, submit application and prescribed documents, pay applicable fees, arrange inspection/sample testing, complete conformity assessment and meet BIS queries/non-conformities. BIS states applications are accepted online and payments are made online. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
required_documents: Application; factory/manufacturing details; product and IS details; manufacturing process information; in-house testing-facility details; quality-control arrangements; relevant technical documents; applicable undertakings/declarations; documents required by the product manual/IS/QCO. Exact documents vary by product.
factory_requirements: Manufacturing premises capable of consistently producing conforming product; adequate production facilities; in-process controls; trained personnel; documented quality controls; facilities necessary for product-specific inspection/testing. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
infrastructure_requirements: Appropriate machinery, production equipment, inspection facilities and in-house testing equipment specified by the relevant Product Manual/SIT. The manufacturer must possess the requisite testing capability for the applicable IS. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
process_controls: Controls specified in the relevant Product Manual and SIT; control of raw materials; process parameters; inspection stages; identification/traceability; handling of non-conforming material/product; calibration and maintenance of equipment; production/testing records.
quality_control: Routine quality control according to applicable Product Manual/SIT; sampling and testing of production; maintenance of records; corrective action for non-conforming results.
testing: Product-specific tests according to applicable IS, Product Manual and SIT. Testing may be performed in the manufacturer's laboratory and/or BIS-recognized laboratory depending on the conformity-assessment route. BIS states conformity may be established through third-party laboratory testing, testing at manufacturing premises, or a combination. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
inspection: BIS inspection of manufacturing and testing infrastructure; verification of production/process controls; scrutiny of records; sample drawal; follow-up inspection/surveillance where applicable.
laboratory_testing: BIS-recognized laboratories are used where external testing is prescribed; laboratory scope must cover the applicable IS/test. BIS maintains a recognized laboratory system through LIMS.
conformity_assessment: Assessment of manufacturing capability + process/QC capability + testing capability + conformity of product to relevant IS + satisfactory inspection/test results. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
licence_or_coc_grant: BIS Licence to use Standard Mark (ISI Mark) after successful conformity assessment and payment of applicable licence/marking fees.
surveillance: Factory surveillance and market surveillance according to BIS guidelines; verification of continued conformity; investigation of non-conformity/unsatisfactory performance. BIS lists separate Factory Surveillance and Market Surveillance guidance. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
renewal: Apply through Manakonline before expiry; submit production details, applicable fee and renewal documents. BIS states Scheme-I licences may initially be granted up to two years and may be renewed up to five years from the last validity date. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
scope_extension: Submit request through applicable BIS scope-change procedure; additional assessment/testing may be required depending on the new variety/product. BIS publishes separate Guidelines for Change in Scope of Licence.
retesting: BIS has separate retesting guidance. Retesting is used where permitted following non-conformity/sample-related cases and is governed by the applicable BIS procedure.
fees: Application fee: ₹1,000; inspection fee: ₹7,000 per man-day; annual licence fee: ₹1,000 + applicable minimum marking fee, according to BIS's current FAQ. Product-specific marking fees apply. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
forms: Application through Manakonline; BIS forms/guidelines applicable to grant, renewal, scope change, retesting and surveillance.
timelines: BIS FAQ states average grant time is generally about 1 month under Option 2 and about 4 months under Option 1 from receipt/recording of a complete application, subject to inspection, testing, queries and fee/payment issues. (Bureau of Indian Standards)

required_documents: Application; factory/manufacturing details; product and IS details; manufacturing process information; in-house testing-facility details; quality-control arrangements; relevant technical documents; applicable undertakings/declarations; documents required by the product manual/IS/QCO. Exact documents vary by product.
factory_requirements: Manufacturing premises capable of consistently producing conforming product; adequate production facilities; in-process controls; trained personnel; documented quality controls; facilities necessary for product-specific inspection/testing. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
infrastructure_requirements: Appropriate machinery, production equipment, inspection facilities and in-house testing equipment specified by the relevant Product Manual/SIT. The manufacturer must possess the requisite testing capability for the applicable IS. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
process_controls: Controls specified in the relevant Product Manual and SIT; control of raw materials; process parameters; inspection stages; identification/traceability; handling of non-conforming material/product; calibration and maintenance of equipment; production/testing records.
quality_control: Routine quality control according to applicable Product Manual/SIT; sampling and testing of production; maintenance of records; corrective action for non-conforming results.
testing: Product-specific tests according to applicable IS, Product Manual and SIT. Testing may be performed in the manufacturer's laboratory and/or BIS-recognized laboratory depending on the conformity-assessment route. BIS states conformity may be established through third-party laboratory testing, testing at manufacturing premises, or a combination. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
inspection: BIS inspection of manufacturing and testing infrastructure; verification of production/process controls; scrutiny of records; sample drawal; follow-up inspection/surveillance where applicable.
laboratory_testing: BIS-recognized laboratories are used where external testing is prescribed; laboratory scope must cover the applicable IS/test. BIS maintains a recognized laboratory system through LIMS.
conformity_assessment: Assessment of manufacturing capability + process/QC capability + testing capability + conformity of product to relevant IS + satisfactory inspection/test results. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
licence_or_coc_grant: BIS Licence to use Standard Mark (ISI Mark) after successful conformity assessment and payment of applicable licence/marking fees.
surveillance: Factory surveillance and market surveillance according to BIS guidelines; verification of continued conformity; investigation of non-conformity/unsatisfactory performance. BIS lists separate Factory Surveillance and Market Surveillance guidance. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
renewal: Apply through Manakonline before expiry; submit production details, applicable fee and renewal documents. BIS states Scheme-I licences may initially be granted up to two years and may be renewed up to five years from the last validity date. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
scope_extension: Submit request through applicable BIS scope-change procedure; additional assessment/testing may be required depending on the new variety/product. BIS publishes separate Guidelines for Change in Scope of Licence.
retesting: BIS has separate retesting guidance. Retesting is used where permitted following non-conformity/sample-related cases and is governed by the applicable BIS procedure.
fees: Application fee: ₹1,000; inspection fee: ₹7,000 per man-day; annual licence fee: ₹1,000 + applicable minimum marking fee, according to BIS's current FAQ. Product-specific marking fees apply. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
forms: Application through Manakonline; BIS forms/guidelines applicable to grant, renewal, scope change, retesting and surveillance.
timelines: BIS FAQ states average grant time is generally about 1 month under Option 2 and about 4 months under Option 1 from receipt/recording of a complete application, subject to inspection, testing, queries and fee/payment issues. (Bureau of Indian Standards)

required_documents: Application; factory/manufacturing details; product and IS details; manufacturing process information; in-house testing-facility details; quality-control arrangements; relevant technical documents; applicable undertakings/declarations; documents required by the product manual/IS/QCO. Exact documents vary by product.
factory_requirements: Manufacturing premises capable of consistently producing conforming product; adequate production facilities; in-process controls; trained personnel; documented quality controls; facilities necessary for product-specific inspection/testing. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
infrastructure_requirements: Appropriate machinery, production equipment, inspection facilities and in-house testing equipment specified by the relevant Product Manual/SIT. The manufacturer must possess the requisite testing capability for the applicable IS. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
process_controls: Controls specified in the relevant Product Manual and SIT; control of raw materials; process parameters; inspection stages; identification/traceability; handling of non-conforming material/product; calibration and maintenance of equipment; production/testing records.
quality_control: Routine quality control according to applicable Product Manual/SIT; sampling and testing of production; maintenance of records; corrective action for non-conforming results.
testing: Product-specific tests according to applicable IS, Product Manual and SIT. Testing may be performed in the manufacturer's laboratory and/or BIS-recognized laboratory depending on the conformity-assessment route. BIS states conformity may be established through third-party laboratory testing, testing at manufacturing premises, or a combination. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
inspection: BIS inspection of manufacturing and testing infrastructure; verification of production/process controls; scrutiny of records; sample drawal; follow-up inspection/surveillance where applicable.
laboratory_testing: BIS-recognized laboratories are used where external testing is prescribed; laboratory scope must cover the applicable IS/test. BIS maintains a recognized laboratory system through LIMS.
conformity_assessment: Assessment of manufacturing capability + process/QC capability + testing capability + conformity of product to relevant IS + satisfactory inspection/test results. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
licence_or_coc_grant: BIS Licence to use Standard Mark (ISI Mark) after successful conformity assessment and payment of applicable licence/marking fees.
surveillance: Factory surveillance and market surveillance according to BIS guidelines; verification of continued conformity; investigation of non-conformity/unsatisfactory performance. BIS lists separate Factory Surveillance and Market Surveillance guidance. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
renewal: Apply through Manakonline before expiry; submit production details, applicable fee and renewal documents. BIS states Scheme-I licences may initially be granted up to two years and may be renewed up to five years from the last validity date. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
scope_extension: Submit request through applicable BIS scope-change procedure; additional assessment/testing may be required depending on the new variety/product. BIS publishes separate Guidelines for Change in Scope of Licence.
retesting: BIS has separate retesting guidance. Retesting is used where permitted following non-conformity/sample-related cases and is governed by the applicable BIS procedure.
fees: Application fee: ₹1,000; inspection fee: ₹7,000 per man-day; annual licence fee: ₹1,000 + applicable minimum marking fee, according to BIS's current FAQ. Product-specific marking fees apply. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
forms: Application through Manakonline; BIS forms/guidelines applicable to grant, renewal, scope change, retesting and surveillance.
timelines: BIS FAQ states average grant time is generally about 1 month under Option 2 and about 4 months under Option 1 from receipt/recording of a complete application, subject to inspection, testing, queries and fee/payment issues. (Bureau of Indian Standards)

eligibility: Manufacturer of products notified under Scheme-X/EEQCO or otherwise brought under compulsory Scheme-X certification. Manufacturer must possess the required manufacturing infrastructure, in-process controls, quality control and testing capabilities and product must conform to the applicable IS. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
application_procedure: Submit Scheme-X application through Manakonline, with required technical file and product-specific documentation; BIS scrutiny; factory assessment; testing/verification; resolution of deficiencies; grant after satisfactory conformity assessment. BIS specifically states an application for Scheme-X should not be submitted without the required Technical File.
required_documents: Application; Technical File; manufacturing/factory details; applicable IS details; drawings/specifications; component information; production-process information; in-process/QC documents; testing-facility details; applicable product-specific documents; declarations/undertakings. Product Manuals identify additional technical-file requirements.
factory_requirements: Adequate manufacturing infrastructure, production facilities, in-process control and quality-control arrangements for the specific product. Separate application is required for each factory location even when product and IS are the same.
infrastructure_requirements: Appropriate production, inspection and testing infrastructure capable of establishing compliance with the applicable IS. Product-specific Product Manual/Scheme-X requirements apply.
process_controls: Product-specific manufacturing/process controls specified in the relevant Product Manual; documented inspection/testing procedures; calibrated equipment; control of components/materials; traceability and records.
quality_control: Product-specific QC system and routine controls; records demonstrate continuing conformity.
testing: Scheme-X allows either testing at BIS/BIS-approved third-party laboratory or witnessing of complete testing at the manufacturer's facility, including subcontracted facilities where applicable. For long-duration tests of 30 days or more, BIS guidance permits certification based on an undertaking while the test is running under specified conditions. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
inspection: BIS factory assessment/witnessing verifies manufacturing infrastructure, process controls, QC and testing capability. Product testing can be witnessed by BIS where applicable.
laboratory_testing: BIS-approved/recognized third-party laboratories can be used; BIS directs applicants to LIMS to identify recognized laboratories for EEQCO products.
conformity_assessment: Manufacturing capability + technical-file review + product testing + factory inspection/witnessing + conformity to applicable IS + satisfaction of Scheme-X/product-specific requirements.
licence_or_coc_grant: BIS Certification Marks Licence under Scheme-X where the product is subject to certification-mark licensing under the applicable compulsory order.
surveillance: Scheme-X/product-specific surveillance and continuing conformity verification as prescribed by BIS.
renewal: Renewal according to applicable Scheme-X/BIS certification provisions and product-specific guidance.
scope_extension: Scope changes/inclusion of additional products or varieties according to Scheme-X change/inclusion guidance and any required reassessment/testing.
retesting: Retesting/reassessment according to applicable Scheme-X procedure where permitted.
fees: Fees are product/process specific; BIS maintains a separate Scheme-X fee section. Exact fee should be retrieved from current Scheme-X fee guidance rather than hard-coded globally.
forms: Manakonline application; Technical File; Scheme-X checklists/guidance; product-specific forms and documents. BIS provides applicant checklists and product-specific guidance. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
timelines: Product-specific. Depends on technical-file completeness, factory assessment, testing duration and resolution of deficiencies.

testing: Scheme-X allows either testing at BIS/BIS-approved third-party laboratory or witnessing of complete testing at the manufacturer's facility, including subcontracted facilities where applicable. For long-duration tests of 30 days or more, BIS guidance permits certification based on an undertaking while the test is running under specified conditions. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
inspection: BIS factory assessment/witnessing verifies manufacturing infrastructure, process controls, QC and testing capability. Product testing can be witnessed by BIS where applicable.
laboratory_testing: BIS-approved/recognized third-party laboratories can be used; BIS directs applicants to LIMS to identify recognized laboratories for EEQCO products.
conformity_assessment: Manufacturing capability + technical-file review + product testing + factory inspection/witnessing + conformity to applicable IS + satisfaction of Scheme-X/product-specific requirements.
licence_or_coc_grant: BIS Certification Marks Licence under Scheme-X where the product is subject to certification-mark licensing under the applicable compulsory order.
surveillance: Scheme-X/product-specific surveillance and continuing conformity verification as prescribed by BIS.
renewal: Renewal according to applicable Scheme-X/BIS certification provisions and product-specific guidance.
scope_extension: Scope changes/inclusion of additional products or varieties according to Scheme-X change/inclusion guidance and any required reassessment/testing.
retesting: Retesting/reassessment according to applicable Scheme-X procedure where permitted.
fees: Fees are product/process specific; BIS maintains a separate Scheme-X fee section. Exact fee should be retrieved from current Scheme-X fee guidance rather than hard-coded globally.
forms: Manakonline application; Technical File; Scheme-X checklists/guidance; product-specific forms and documents. BIS provides applicant checklists and product-specific guidance. (Bureau of Indian Standards)
timelines: Product-specific. Depends on technical-file completeness, factory assessment, testing duration and resolution of deficiencies.
